Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
go_block('alert_log');
first_record ;
loop
 if :alert_log.user_id = :system_users.user_id then
 show_error('11257') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 if :system.last_record != 'TRUE' then
 next_record ;
 else
 exit ; 
 end if ;
end loop ;

last_record ;
if :alert_log.user_id is not null then
 next_record ;
end if ;

:alert_log.user_id := :system_users.user_id ;
:alert_log.user_name := :system_users.user_name ;

Block.Name: SYSTEM_USERS
Block.WhereClause:
where ( 
user_id like '%'||UPPER(:alert_messages.search_txt)||'%'
OR USER_FIRST_NAME like '%'||UPPER(:alert_messages.search_txt)||'%'
OR USER_LAST_NAME like '%'||UPPER(:alert_messages.search_txt)||'%'
 ) and 
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
:system_users.user_name := Initcap(:system_users.user_first_name)||' '|| Initcap(:system_users.user_last_name) ;

DECLARE
 CURSOR dept_cur IS SELECT INITCAP(valid_master_codes.description) Dept_name 
 FROM employees,
 valid_master_codes
 WHERE valid_master_codes.code = employees.dept_id 
 AND valid_master_codes.code_type = 'DEPTS' 
 AND employees.staff_no = :system_users.staff_no ;
BEGIN
 FOR dept_rec IN dept_cur 
 LOOP 
 :system_users.dept_name := dept_rec.dept_name ;
 END LOOP ;
END ;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- Modified for Y2K.....MG.....6/99
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
BEGIN
 disable_toolbar_initial ;
 --:global.program_version := '1.01.01';
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.00';
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '03';
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- IM 8497
 -- :global.program_version := '05'; -- Duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 :global.program_version := '01';
 
 execute_trigger('util_banner') ;
 Default_Value(NULL,'GLOBAL.msg_id');
 go_block('SYSTEM_USERS') ; execute_query ;
 IF :GLOBAL.msg_id is not null THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT msg_text
 INTO :ALERT_MESSAGES.msg_text
 FROM alert_messages b,system_users a
 WHERE msg_id = :GLOBAL.msg_id
 AND b.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 AND a.user_id=b.insert_user;
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 :ALERT_MESSAGES.msg_text := '';
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;
 END;
 END IF;
-- go_item('MSG_TEXT');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_NAVIGATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SET_NAVIGATION (F_NAME IN VARCHAR2,FLG IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 IF FLG = 'T' THEN 
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_false);
 set_item_property(F_NAME,ENABLED,PROPERTY_false);
 END IF;
END;
